verdict.rationale: The SDK provides programmatic building blocks for fanning work out across many items: subagents that can be spawned programmatically to run multiple analyses in parallel, and an agent loop that runs tools until the task completes. The shared Claude Code foundation also documents several ways to work on many tasks at once, including agent teams. However, no dedicated bulk or batch operation primitive is evidenced, so developers must build the iteration and fan-out logic themselves. Missing for 10: a first-class batch or bulk-operation API, SDK-specific documentation of bulk processing patterns, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workloads.
